function_signature: (Dirac-type operator D, time t) → (Str e^{-tD²} = index density)
description: Computes the index of a Dirac-type operator by evaluating the t-independent supertrace of the heat kernel and taking its short-time asymptotic expansion to extract the local characteristic-class index density (McKean–Singer).
Parallel-transports along loops and applies gauge transformations to a connection, producing holonomy phases and the inhomogeneous transformation law of the local gauge potential.

function_signature: (simplicial complex K) → (Euler characteristic χ = Σ(-1)^n c_n)
description: Computes the Euler characteristic of a complex as the alternating sum of simplex counts and equates it, via homology, to the alternating sum of Betti numbers.

function_signature: (order-parameter space G/H, dimension n) → (π_n(G/H) defect classes)
description: Classifies stable topological defects of an ordered medium by computing the homotopy groups of the order-parameter coset space G/H.

function_signature: (gauge-fixed worldsheet CFT, ghosts) → (central charge c, critical dimension)
description: Computes the total Virasoro central charge from matter and Faddeev–Popov ghost sectors and imposes its cancellation to fix the critical spacetime dimension and remove the conformal anomaly.
